info.syllabusName: Chuyên đề định hướng nghề nghiệp - Marketing (Career in Marketing)
info.description:
Chapter 1: Marketing careers in the twenty-first century

Chapter 2: Careers in Marketing research

Chapter 3: Careers in Product development

Chapter 4: Careers in Advertising and sales promotion

Chapter 5: Careers in  Public relations and customer service

Chapter 6: Careers In Industrial, Wholesale, And Direct Sales

Chapter 7: Marketing Management And Global Marketing

Chapter 8: Building A Personal Brand
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: Apply basic knowledge of careers in marketing related to the profession in marketing, marketing management, knowledge of the career development of each individual in the society and personal branding.
Apply skills to plan for future career development, selective skills, job placement related to marketing, recruitment.
Apply a positive attitude, independent, self-development and proactive learning. Clear orientation and determination to pursue a chosen marketing career.
